R1.description: Every Codex worker ending that leaves a clone on disk names its path in reconciliation_evidence.clone (a LAUNCHED reconciliation, a drifted resume, an abandon, a tree_left ending), proved by a test per ending, and the guides say so

R2.description: A recovery whose clone was already removed reports clone_kept false and clone_removed true instead of a kept clone, proved by the window (b) test with the branch moved

R3.description: The landing tests use per-test job ids so overlapping tests cannot share an ownership tag

R4.description: The drifted resume of a LAUNCHED Codex record has a test of its own, first against the unchanged behaviour and then asserting the clone is named

R5.description: The sandbox-only FakeLaunchTest failures are reproduced and their cause is recorded and acted on by cause, or reported open with the evidence
